native.scope:
Original x86 DrawIfVisible/Draw_It guard probe; no game/Windows/rasterizer.

Uses a private supported executable, never writes its bytes. The image getter,
projection, map/cell, tint/height and final DrawSHP API are fixture boundaries.
The original visibility, fade, frame selection and draw-submission instructions
run unchanged. This tests draw eligibility, not a live terminal-frame sequence.
native.conclusion: Alive=0 does not suppress original DrawIfVisible or Draw_It; limbo and Invisible do. TimeToDie is not a Draw_It guard; the reader deliberately keeps its existing exclusion as a conservative lifecycle constraint. No live terminal-state causality is established.

synthetic_pixel_regression.scope:
Independent production capture/decoder/cache pixels for a held building slot.

Reuses only the public host fixture's file/time/memory boundaries and helpers.
Its unrelated overlay/terrain/voxel assertions are not executed. The 24-frame
SHP and palette are synthetic; no game process, private art or Windows visual
acceptance is involved. Windows uses its real ABI with named API redirection.
